description: Unidirectional motor drive in a cement plant with remote start/stop and safety interlock

inputs.name: EBFE
inputs.reason: The start button remotely starts the motor via this input

inputs.name: EBFA
inputs.reason: The stop button remotely stops the motor via this input

inputs.name: EBVG
inputs.reason: The sensor output provides a remote safety operating interlock into the motor via this input

outputs.name: EVS
outputs.description: Running signal in automatic or single-start mode
outputs.reason: Only the main output signal is needed to indicate the motor is running
